shortDescription: Manages an RRset in a zone of PowerDNS Authoritative server

options.name: A
options.description: RR of type A. At least one RR type is required if O(state=present) or O(state=absent) and O(type) is not present.

options.name: AAAA
options.description: RR of type AAAA. At least one RR type is required if O(state=present) or O(state=absent) and O(type) is not present.

options.name: CAA
options.description: Certificate Authority Authorization RR. At least one RR type is required if O(state=present) or O(state=absent) and O(type) is not present.

options.name: CNAME
options.description: Canonical name RR. At least one RR type is required if O(state=present) or O(state=absent) and O(type) is not present.

options.name: DNSKEY
options.description: DNS Key RR for DNSSEC. At least one RR type is required if O(state=present) or O(state=absent) and O(type) is not present.

options.name: DS
options.description: Delegation Signer RR for DNSSEC. At least one RR type is required if O(state=present) or O(state=absent) and O(type) is not present.

options.name: HINFO
options.description: Host information RR. At least one RR type is required if O(state=present) or O(state=absent) and O(type) is not present.

options.name: HTTPS
options.description: HTTPS service binding RR. At least one RR type is required if O(state=present) or O(state=absent) and O(type) is not present.

options.name: LOC
options.description: Location RR. At least one RR type is required if O(state=present) or O(state=absent) and O(type) is not present.

options.name: MX
options.description: Mail exchange RR. At least one RR type is required if O(state=present) or O(state=absent) and O(type) is not present.

options.name: NAPTR
options.description: Name Authority Pointer RR. At least one RR type is required if O(state=present) or O(state=absent) and O(type) is not present.

options.name: NS
options.description: Name server RR. At least one RR type is required if O(state=present) or O(state=absent) and O(type) is not present.

options.name: PTR
options.description: Pointer RR for reverse DNS lookup. At least one RR type is required if O(state=present) or O(state=absent) and O(type) is not present.

options.name: RP
options.description: Responsible person RR. At least one RR type is required if O(state=present) or O(state=absent) and O(type) is not present.

options.name: SOA
options.description: Start of Authority RR. At least one RR type is required if O(state=present) or O(state=absent) and O(type) is not present.

options.name: SPF
options.description: Sender Policy Framework RR. At least one RR type is required if O(state=present) or O(state=absent) and O(type) is not present.

options.name: SRV
options.description: Service RR. At least one RR type is required if O(state=present) or O(state=absent) and O(type) is not present.

options.name: SSHFP
options.description: SSH fingerprint RR. At least one RR type is required if O(state=present) or O(state=absent) and O(type) is not present.

options.name: SVCB
options.description: Service binding RR. At least one RR type is required if O(state=present) or O(state=absent) and O(type) is not present.

options.name: TLSA
options.description: Transport Layer Security Authentication RR. At least one RR type is required if O(state=present) or O(state=absent) and O(type) is not present.

options.name: TXT
options.description: Text RR. At least one RR type is required if O(state=present) or O(state=absent) and O(type) is not present.

options.name: api_key
options.description: Key (token) used to authenticate to the API endpoint in the server.

options.name: api_spec_path
options.description: Path of the OpenAPI (Swagger) API spec document in C(api_url).

options.name: api_url
options.description: URL of the API endpoint in the server.

options.name: keep
options.description: Whether or not to keep existing records.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the RRset Required if O(state=present) or O(state=absent)

options.name: records
options.description: Represents a list of RRs. Required if O(type) and O(state=present).

options.name: server_id
options.description: ID of the server instance which holds the key.

options.name: state
options.description: If V(present) the RRset will be created unless it already exists in which case if O(keep=false) RRs will be replaced and if O(keep=true) new RRs will be added. If V(absent) and O(keep=false) the whole RRset will be deleted If V(absent) and O(keep=true) only the matching RRs will be deleted If V(exists) a list of all RRsets in the zone will be returned If V(exists) and O(name) and/or O(type) existence will be checked and matching RRsets will be returned

options.name: ttl
options.description: TTL of the records, in seconds.

options.name: type
options.description: Type of resource record (e.g. A, PTR...). Required if O(state=absent) or O(state=present) and none of the RR type options are provided.

options.name: zone_name
options.description: Name of the zone
